findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_ai_sentiment_driver" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read one sentiment theme with quotes and suggested tasks; the summary and tasks are written on first read. themeKey comes from get_ai_sentiment_overview.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
